description: A robed figure with an arrow in its head tilts back and falls leftwards toward the horse while a second arrow flies in from the right edge across f9052-9057; riders do not visibly move.
A red-fletched arrow appears at right at f9052 and travels leftward/lower across tiles.
Fallen robed figures slide and stack further right of the horse, rotating to horizontal; arrows remain upright. Final tiles show two or three bodies overlapped.

Rider and horse stay fixed in tile; handwritten label "Mongol horse archer" moves vertically in the tile (down f9097-9100, then settling around y~300) and is in view; likely the label sliding/bouncing in. Reveal style cannot be stated.
Rider and horse grow larger across tiles; label and curved arrow move up and exit frame by f9184-9187 (arrow only at f9184), consistent with a push-in.
Empty board at f9354; a dim, small picture appears at f9355, grows and brightens f9356-9358, then settles at f9359-9361 (scale-up fade-in).
Pointer stick tilts and drops toward the lower right across f9358-9361 while the lecturer shifts slightly.
Lecturer shifts rightwards and down in tile and pointer drops to the floor line; painting is static.
Globe with figures grows from small to large tile coverage with figures riding along; globe also shifts left/down.

Text "Estimated deaths: 40 million" is progressively uncovered left-to-right as it emerges from behind the right edge of the globe: "n" at f9520, "illion" f9521, "40 million" f9522, "...aths: 40 million" f9523, nearly full by f9527.
Globe shrinks and moves left across tiles while text emerges.
Lecturer sinks lower behind lectern (f9743-9746) then a green leaf item shows at lectern edge by f9747-9750; board and number static.
Lecturer is standing with torso visible; pointer rotates from low-left (f9758) upward to near-vertical pointing at board by f9764-9765.
Map shifts slightly and box moves leftward/downward in frame; gradual drift across tiles (small displacement).
Strong push-in: box grows from about 60 px to about 130 px tile width, Europe enlarges and background darkens.
